notes: Adapt T in the theorem statement from MultilinearMap ℂ M N to MultilinearMap (RingHom.id ℂ) M N. The target parameterizes multilinear maps by a scalar ring homomorphism; specializing to the identity preserves ordinary complex multilinearity, since (RingHom.id ℂ) c = c. The same functions, additive laws and complex scalar laws are quantified over; no mathematical assumptions or conclusions change. The proof is unchanged.
